title: Field guide demo: sexing a pied kingfisher
storyboard: Film: top-down hands flipping a bird field guide to the kingfisher plate, finger tracing breast bands
caption:
Your field guide can tell you more than the name

Pied kingfishers hunt with a hover-plunge: they drop lower and lower over the water, then dive.
